title: sine scroller
shortDescription: An old-school Amiga screen: a chrome bitmap-font scroller on a sine, colour cycling, rolling copper bars and light sabers that bloom
description: A demo screen as the Amiga drew them, pixel art at a whole-number scale: the `OrthographicProjection` of the `Stage2D` takes a `pixelZoom` that the page sets on every resize. The **scroller** is the font `chrome-32`, read by `BitmapFont.parse()` and laid out once by `writeText()` — one sprite per glyph. The CPU only moves each glyph along x and wraps it around; `wave({weight: 'uniform'})` bends the row on a sine in the shader, its phase taken from the x of each glyph, so the letters ride the wave as they pass ([Waves: sway and scroller](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/sprites.md#waves-sway-and-scroller), [A sine scroller](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/text.md#a-sine-scroller)). Its colours run through the letters by `PaletteSwap`: `paletteCycle` names entries 1–15 of the font's palette — entry 0, the outline, stays — and `paletteShift` follows the time; *font* switches the row the glyphs are drawn in. The **tunnel** behind is a spiral of 16 greys that turns by colour cycling alone, all 16 entries, in the row *tunnel* picks ([Palette swap and colour cycling](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/sprites.md#palette-swap-and-colour-cycling)). The **light sabers** glow by the recipe of the guide: a `Tint` above 1 in their own hue and a stage that blooms through `createBloomOutputNodeBuilder({threshold: 1})`. The bloom compares luminance, so the red saber takes `[3, 0.9, 0.9]` — a pure red would need a factor of 5 — and lifts only the white core of its strip above 1; the chrome takes a tint of 1.3, so only its white bands bloom, and the pixel-8 title a cyan one. On every beat a `Flash` towards a white above white bursts through the sabers ([Glow: emissive sprites with bloom](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/sprites.md#glow-emissive-sprites-with-bloom)). *bloom* takes the builder off the renderer, *beat flash* stops the flash. The copper bars roll behind it all, sorted by the depth test. The assets are generated by `apps/lookbook/assets-src/sine-scroller/`.
